narrative.location: TOI-700 lies 101.52 light-years (31.127 pc) from the Sun.
narrative.host_star: TOI-700 is a M2.5 V star with 0.415× the Sun's mass and 0.421× its radius (effective temperature 3459 K, versus the Sun's 5772 K).
narrative.system: It is a single star hosting 4 known planets.
narrative.planet: TOI-700 d is 1.07× Earth's radius, an estimated 1.25× Earth's mass, inferred from its radius rather than measured, completing one orbit every 37.4 days at 0.1633 AU, on a mildly eccentric orbit (e = 0.04).
narrative.climate: It receives about 0.85× the flux Earth gets from the Sun, for an equilibrium temperature near 244 K (Earth's is 254 K).

visualisation_disclaimer: Any rendering of this world is a scientifically informed visualisation, not an image. No exoplanet has been imaged at surface resolution. Surface and cloud appearance are illustrative of a physically plausible class, not observations.

mass_earth.class_meaning: NOT measured. Predicted from the radius by a mass-radius relation, so it carries no information beyond the radius.

equilibrium_temperature_k.note: Equilibrium temperature excludes greenhouse warming by construction. Earth's is 254 K against a 288 K surface.

habitable_zone.model: Kopparapu et al. (2013), ApJ 765, 131, with the 2013 erratum coefficients

earth_similarity.caveat: A similarity metric on bulk properties. Not a probability of habitability, and not evidence of life. Venus scores 0.93 on the same metric.

observability.tsm_note: Kempton et al. (2018) Transmission Spectroscopy Metric. Undefined for non-transiting planets.

transmission_spectrum.message: No published transmission spectrum exists for this planet in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

light_curve.author: SPOC
light_curve.note: stitched 1 product(s), mission default quality mask applied

t0_time_system.note: Published BJD midpoint converted to the mission offset time system.

fit.caveat: Depth is fitted with a trapezoid and is not corrected for limb darkening; the derived radius ratio is therefore an overestimate of a few percent in the optical. Published catalogue radii use limb-darkened models and take precedence.

catalogue_check.interpretation: Fitted depth disagrees with the published value. In a multi-planet system this usually means the fold is contaminated by other planets' transits rather than isolating the target. This fit is NOT reported as a measurement.

rv_analysis.instrument_offset_note: A per-instrument median was subtracted. Combining spectrographs -- or one spectrograph across a hardware intervention -- without this injects a step into the time series, which a periodogram converts into spurious long-period power.

activity_coincidences.interpretation: This RV period coincides with a periodicity in a stellar activity indicator measured from the same spectra. The signal is consistent with stellar activity and must not be treated as a planet without further argument.
